cvEn:
Haim Turgeman Turgeman, son of Iza and Meir, was born on 30 Kislev 5709 (1 December 1948) in Morocco. He immigrated to Israel with his family at the age of ten. Haim began his schooling in Morocco and continued in Israel at the Sinai and Gaulim schools in Kiryat Yam, where his family settled.

A lover of adventure, he decided to become a sailor at the age of fourteen. For ten years he served in various roles on different ships and saw much of the world. When he returned to dry land, he went to Germany and worked for several years as an entertainment promoter. Some time later he married Fanny. The couple settled in Ashdod, and Haim earned his living as a decorator.

Haim was drafted into the IDF as a reserve soldier in the middle of December 1977 and was sent to basic training. According to his commander, Haim performed his duties in basic training properly.

Haim died on 17 Shevat 5738 (25 January 1978). He was laid to rest in the Tzur Shalom civilian cemetery. He left behind a wife, his parents, three brothers, and four sisters.
